title: What Steps Must the U.S. Take to Repair Democracy?
author: John Harwood
content:
The midterm rebuke of MAGA has shown that American democracy is far from
powerless. But with a change in congressional power coming, what are the steps
the country should take to repair the damage from MAGA politics?

Pulitzer Prize-winning historian **Anne Applebaum** joins **Zeteo 's John
Harwood** to lay out exactly what it would take to rebuild U.S. institutions
and rein in corruption.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch the full, wide-ranging conversation, to hear Applebaum explain what
makes **" our political system one of the most corrupt democracies in the
world," **why future presidents need to **" bend over backwards"** for our
allies, and which previously accepted norms (that Trump threw out the window)
now need to be codified by law.
